q: Does silica fume carry carbon from the silicon smelter that made it?
title: Silica fume carbon allocation
short: Silica fume is collected from the off gas of silicon and ferrosilicon furnaces. Many methods treat it as a residue that carries only its collection, densifying and transport emissions; others allocate part of the smelter's burden. State which rule you used.
audience: Concrete makers, admixture suppliers and silicon smelters

ul: Residue: only bagging, densifying and freight.
By product: a share of smelter emissions by mass or value.
Whichever you pick, apply it every year.

p: Silica fume replaces some cement, so the rule decides how much credit a low carbon concrete mix can claim.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
